sections.text:
[Effects]
The following will activate if your Class is Cleric:
Increases HP recovery effects of a healing Ability by L.
Increases the target's max HP for 20 seconds by S.
Ability Power scales with the number of Star elemental Book/Relic type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of 3XL+ (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 10).

[Activation]
When a healing Ability is used.
Only activates when playing as Cleric.

[Activation Rate]
M
Activation rate scales with the number of Star elemental Book/Relic type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of XL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 10).
